title: Mayura
desc: Mayura, a Brahmin boy, discovers his connections to the royal family. He then takes it upon himself to avenge the death of his father and works towards building his kingdom.

title: Veeran
desc: Kumaran, a teenage boy, gets struck by lightning and goes into a coma. He wakes up realising that he has superhuman abilities post the accident.

title: Gooli
desc: Trouble ensues when a kind-hearted woman, Ramya, falls for an unruly thug, Gooli. Though they marry, the couple part ways and encounter a tragedy.

title: Seetharama Kalyana
desc: Arya is an altruistic individual who constantly sacrifices his happiness for his loved ones. Consequently, his romance with innocent Geetha faces severe hurdles.

title: S. P. Sangliyana Part 2
desc: After Sangliyana, an honest cop, arrests a powerful kingpin's daughter, his life is thrown into chaos. His act of bravery pits him against a criminal empire determined to destroy him.

title: Athi Aparoopa
desc: Upset due to his father's remarriage, Bharath leaves home. Eventually, he meets Aparna, a beautiful woman, and falls in love with her, unaware of her secret.

title: Matsara
desc: When a rich businessman's daughter marries a factory worker, he tries to break them up by killing his son-in-law. Years later, his grandson decides to seek revenge for his father's murder.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kunthi Puthra
desc: Surya, a feared aid to the don, is assigned a job to kidnap the daughter of a wealthy businessman. However, he begins to fall in love with her.

title: Cheluveye Ninne Nodalu
desc: Vishwa, a local tourist guide, falls deeply in love with Prakruthi. However, Prakruthi's parents forcibly arrange her marriage to a wealthy businessman.
